message.content: {"caption":"Workflow separating skill evolution from benchmark evaluation.","description":"A left-to-right process diagram shows available inputs—task T, workspace W, initial skill S₀, and frozen agent π—feeding stub evolution during evolution. Stub evolution uses paired audits, PACE, and a task-compiled verifier. After evolution terminates, the agent is evaluated under no-skill, curated-skill, and evolved-skill conditions; post-evolution evaluation uses a benchmark verifier to assign task reward. A red note states that the benchmark verifier, test content, and task reward are unavailable during evolution.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
